landing.heroDesc: Iḥsān is to worship Allah as though you see Him. This is your companion for that path — salat, zikr, Quran, fasting, and the gentle numbers that keep you going. Free, ad-free, and honest with every reference.
landing.noAds: No ads · no subscriptions · your data stays yours
landing.rayhanahHighlight: A first among Muslim productivity apps
landing.rayhanahDesc: Allah Himself excused women from salat and fasting during their days — so Ihsan does too, with zero guilt. Cycle tracking with predictions and wellness notes, a ghusl guide, Ramadan days flowing into the make-up counter automatically, and a Noor score that keeps shining from dhikr, Quran and ṣalawāt. Completely private:
landing.verifiedDesc: Each Quran verse and hadith in Ihsan links to quran.com or sunnah.com with its exact number, and grades are shown where they matter. No fabricated virtues, no folklore — if we can't verify it, we don't say it.
landing.fajrTitle: Your day begins at Fajr — not midnight
landing.fajrDesc: Isha prayed after midnight and suhoor before dawn belong to the right day, because Ihsan's tracking day flows the way a worship day actually does: dawn to dawn.
landing.genderPickerTitle: How would you like to explore?
landing.genderPickerDesc: Choose a demo profile — you can explore all features freely.
landing.featureSalatDesc: All five prayers with on-time, late and missed states — plus sunnah and nafl. Mark the tasbīḥ after a prayer and it logs to your zikr count on its own; Āyatul Kursī and the post-salat surahs are one tap away.
landing.featureZikrDesc: A beautiful tap counter with goals, fair streaks that give you a grace day, and a verified library of ṣalawāt, istighfār and the weighty words — with Arabic, transliteration and the exact reference for each.
landing.featureQuranDesc: An āyah-by-āyah reader with recitation, word highlighting, Bengali & English translations, a khatam journey, seven reciters, and one unified streak.
landing.featureFastingDesc: Qaḍā, kaffārah, vows and every sunnah day — each rule cited to its exact hadith. And a dedicated Ramadan home with suhoor, iftar, tarawih and Laylat al-Qadr.
landing.featurePrayerDesc: Computed fully on your device — your location never leaves your browser. Live countdowns, forbidden windows, nafl windows.
landing.featureFriendsDesc: "So compete with one another in doing good" (Quran 2:148). Connect with one link and race each other gently with Noor — a calm daily light out of 100.
